dict.string: HinglishVoice uses on-device speech recognition to accurately process your Hinglish voice commands without sending audio data to external servers.
Microphone access is required to listen to your voice commands for reminders, calls, and navigation.
HinglishVoice needs access to your Reminders to create and manage reminders from your voice commands.
HinglishVoice creates reminders in your Reminders app when you command in Hinglish.
Contacts access allows HinglishVoice to resolve spoken names like 'Rahul' or 'Mummy' when you make calls or send messages.
